runs.t: Pax got a big red box from his dad.
“Look at the box!” Pax said to Rex.
Pax jumps in the big red box.
“Can you help me, Pax?” said Rex.
“Yes! I can help you,” said Pax.
Pax helps Rex get in the box.
Pax and Rex jump in the box.
“The box is fun!” said Pax and Rex.
